 Order

. The petitioner in this petition seeks directions to the respondents to conclude the acquisition proceedings expeditiously with respect to land of petitioner measuring 11 Marlas falling under Khasra No. 1698 situated at Village Fhagaw Doligam Tehsil Banihal District Ramban and he further sought direction upon the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner on account of land Mohd Sultan Naik vs Union Territory Of J&K on 5 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69805501/
1 consumed by the respondents over which New Type Primary Health Center (NTPHC) has been constructed and also seeks a direction upon the respondents to pay rental compensation for the use and occupation of the above said land till acquisitions proceedings are concluded.
02.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has referred to Para-9 of the objections filed by the respondents.

In Para-9, respondent-Collector has submitted that Indenting Department i.e. Director Health Services Jammu placed a fresh indent to the Deputy Commissioner Ramban vide his letter No.DHSJ/PLG/Land-Acquisition/20-21/249-53 dated:- 11.06.2020 which was forwarded to the Collectorate vide No:- DC/LA/Rbn/685-89 Dated:-
11.07.2020 and the land acquisition proceedings under Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act SMVT 1990 stands repealed and further acquisition of the land are to be dealt under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 and the Collectorate has requested Chief Medical Officer Ramban for placement of fresh indent in devised format through proper channel and once the indent is made, they would proceed under the said.
03. In view of the reply filed by the Collector Land Acquisition, SDM Banihal, this petition has become infructuous and the same is, accordingly, dismissed.
04. The petitioner is at liberty to approach this Court if fresh cause survives.
(VINOD CHATTERJI KOUL) Judge JAMMU RAM MURTI/PS 05.06.2024 Mohd Sultan Naik vs Union Territory Of J&K on 5 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69805501/
